title: Who was big when? 126 seasons of English league football on one map
excerpt: Every English league club since 1888 on one map, sized by its crowd: 41.2 million at league matches in 1948-49, 16.5 million in 1985-86, a game that moved south, and 39 towns that lost their league club.
seo_description: Every English league club since 1888 mapped by league position and crowd: the 1948-49 peak, the 1980s low, the move south and 39 lost towns.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Who was big when?' in black, claret and orange on cream, beside a map of England and Wales in 1948-49 with a circle for every league club sized by its home crowd and coloured by division, biggest in the North West, Newcastle, the Midlands and London.
